svg.title: Gaussians
svg.desc: Plot: two Gaussian probability curves for a robot's x position. The red "high uncertainty" curve is centered at 0 and is wide and flat, peaking near 0.27 with a standard deviation of about 1.5. The blue "low uncertainty" curve is centered at 2 and is narrow and tall, peaking near 0.8 with a standard deviation of about 0.5. The narrower blue estimate is the more trustworthy sensor reading.
